name: CredentialRequirements Issuer (custom authentication provider)
description: Issues a Power of Attorney only after a custom authentication provider's data satisfies the requirements
summary: NOOP wallet illustrating a CredentialRequirements issuer that gates issuance on data from a custom authentication provider or authentic source (authorization openidCustom, authnProviderUrl) instead of a live credential presentation. A Power of Attorney credential (jwt_vc_vcdm) is issued only once the authentication service's returned data satisfies the requirements; unlike a VPDriven issuer there is no mapping, the authentic-source values are checked as requirements, not copied into the credential. Use oauthCustom instead of openidCustom when the flow must be compatible with the EUDI reference wallet.
